description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/domain/precheck (single $0.02, bulk $0.25; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?domain=example.com (tier=single), or POST {domains:[...]} with tier=bulk. Registration verdict (registered, likely_unregistered or unknown) with age and status flags from registry RDAP, DNS, TLS, a look-alike similarity signal and an optional OFAC SDN address screen. Failed or throttled sources are unknown, never available. Not a guarantee of availability or safety; not legal advice. .dev and .app are not supported: a request with only those names is refused before payment; in a bulk batch they are removed before payment and the flat price still applies.
